observations.content: System sends 7 notification types: @mention, comment_reply, task_assigned, due_date_reminder, weekly_digest, team_announcement, system_maintenance
Each notification fires on both email and in-app channels; no per-channel control exists
NotificationService.send(userId, type, payload) is the single dispatch path; checks no user preferences
Email delivery via SendGrid, in-app via WebSocket push to connected clients
Average user receives 23 notifications/day; power users in large teams receive 80+
Email open rate for notification emails: 12%, down from 34% six months ago
Support ticket volume for 'too many emails' increased 4x in Q1; now #2 most common complaint
3 enterprise customers escalated notification spam as a blocker for renewal
Users report getting task_assigned emails for tasks they were later removed from; no unassign notification or preference exists
Power users are creating email filters to auto-archive all app emails, then missing critical system_maintenance alerts
Some users mute entire Slack channels that mirror app notifications, defeating the team coordination purpose
Best practice: group notifications by urgency tier (immediate/daily/weekly), not by technical type
Best practice: notification preferences page should be reachable from every notification (email footer link, in-app notification menu)
Screen readers cannot parse toggle grids without proper ARIA labels and grouping; each toggle needs a descriptive label, not just the notification type name
CAN-SPAM and GDPR require a one-click unsubscribe mechanism in every commercial email; marketing emails must have it, transactional emails should have it
GDPR Article 21: users have right to object to processing for direct marketing; notification preferences are a data processing consent surface
Existing settings page has sections: Profile, Security, Integrations. No Notifications section. Uses a tabbed layout with a sidebar nav
Settings API follows PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/settings with partial update semantics
users table has no notification_preferences column or related table
User model has timezone field (used for due_date_reminder scheduling)
